messages:
mira: Finance needs a small, operational pricing playbook for pilot launches focusing on burst-cap handling and add-on gating. Can product + legal + infra do a rapid draft?
tony: Scope: define soft vs hard caps, burst packs, overage math, approval matrix, and rollback flow. Keep examples.
sofia: Sales feedback: customers want predictable event capacity (marketing spikes). They prefer buying burst packs in advance instead of ad-hoc overage.
legal-team: No open-ended burst commitments in MSAs. We can allow fixed, prepaid burst packs and explicit overage formulas. Also need audit & dispute language.
devops-bot: FYI: we can emit events for cap_warn, cap_exceeded, burst_pack_consumed. Enforcement path: throttle -> 429 + header with purchase link.
greg: Suggested tier sketch: hobby, pro, scale, enterprise. Add-ons: burst-pack, reserved-nodes, long-retention-logs. Propose default daily soft caps: 5k, 75k, 250k, 2M.
mira: Example billing snippet to include in docs:
""
Customer used 1.2M tokens in 24h. Plan: Scale (250k soft cap), purchased 1M burst-pack at $1000. Overage computed on remaining  (1.2M - 1.25M) = 0 -> no extra charge.
If overage >0, charge at tiered rate list.
""
tony: Launch checklist (must have): signed pilot MSAs (3), published pricing page w/ examples, infra alerts, contract redline, sales playbook snippets.
sofia: I'll collect candidate pilot customers and propose pack sizes they might buy.
legal-team: I'll draft a 1-pager with required contract language and a short FAQ.
devops-bot: Implementation note: fallback should route to smaller model with 95% of latency SLA and emit incident if more than 3 falls in 1h.
mira: Action owners: @greg infra hooks by Tue, @legal-team redline by Tue EOD, @sofia pilot mapping by Wed, I'll assemble playbook Wed night. Quick sync Thu 9:30. :thumbsup:
